AT APPROXIMATELY 0930 HRS. A REPORT WAS RECEIVED OF A RAINBOW FUEL SHEEN IN THE WATER ON THE NORTH SIDE OF THE SHILSHOLE BAY MARINA FUEL DOCK. MARINA STAFF RESPONDED AND LOCATED THE SOURCE OF THE SPILL. THE SOURCE OF THE DIESEL FUEL WAS COMING FROM THE 56' RECREATION VESSEL, LAZY DUCK IV. THE VESSEL OWNER WAS CONTACTED ON BOARD HIS BOAT AT I DOCK, SLIP 17 AT SHILSHOLE BAY MARINA. THE OWNER INDICATED THAT HE HAD TRANSFERRED DIESEL FUEL FROM ONE TANK TO ANOTHER AND SOME OF THE DIESEL SPILLED OUT THE AIR VENT ONTO THE AFT DECK. VESSEL OWNER HAD A CREW CLEANING THE DECK AND THE FUEL WAS WASHED OVERBOARD INTO THE WATER. VESSEL OWNER WAS TOLD NOT TO ALLOW FUEL TO GO INTO THE WATER.

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 43.007015, -88.854972 (Approximated from route)
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTS A PASSENGER WORK TRUCK WAS INVOLVED IN A TRAFFIC ACCIDENT. THE RESPONDING FIRE DEPARTMENT DISCOVERED THAT THIS TRUCK IS CARRYING A CONTAINER OF RADIOACTIVE MATERIALS THAT WITH DIMENSIONS 2FT X 1.5 FT X 3 FT. IT IS AN ORANGE CARRYING CASE CLEARLY MARKED AS CONTAINING RADIOACTIVE MATERIALS. THE VEHICLE DOES NOT HAVE A DOT NUMBER AND IS NOT DISPLAYING A PLACARD. ASSOCIATED DOCUMENTS INDICATE THE CONTENTS AS FOLLOWS: CESIUM-137 - 79 MILLICURIES, AMERICUM-241 / BERYLLIUM - 350 MILLICURIES, RADIUM-226 - 38.5 MILLICURIES. THE DOCUMENTS INDICATE THAT THESE ARE "SEALED SOURCES." THE CASE WAS JOSTLED IN THE ACCIDENT, BUT THERE IS NO APPARENT DAMAGE OR RELEASE AT THIS TIME. THE LOCAL FIRE DEPARTMENT ON-SCENE IS FOLLOWING THE EMERGENCY RESPONSE MEASURES ON THE ATTACHED PAPERWORK, WHICH INDICATE STAYING 10-15 AWAY AND UPWIND FROM THE INCIDENT. THE DRIVER DECLINED TRANSPORT TO THE HOSPITAL. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT IS SEEKING HIGHER-LEVEL GUIDANCE ON HOW TO PROCEED, BUT IS CURRENTLY WORKING WITH THE RESPONSIBLE COMPANY FOR FURTHER REMEDIATION EFFORTS.
